name: Local Music Generation (MusicGen)
purpose: Generate one short piece of instrumental music from a text prompt with a local MusicGen model. Drives transformers MusicgenForConditionalGeneration (CUDA) via a Python worker (music_gen_infer.py) under the speech venv with a meta-file hand-off to a PowerShell wrapper (the D-0021 speech.tts pattern). Resolves the music-gen model from models.json (type=music-gen), decoupled from the gateway wired gate. Produces a 32 kHz mono WAV; an optional non-wav -Format / -SampleRate is produced by composing audio.ingest (#10). Binds the CUDA context / VRAM, so parallel_safe:false. Populates confidence (a generation-completeness / non-silent heuristic) + model_provenance and routes failed / silent / low-confidence generations to the review queue (the ninth producer). Default model music.musicgen-small (MusicGen Small, transformers, CC-BY-NC-4.0). The music-generation sibling of gen.audio (#22, procedural sound) and gen.image (#23, neural images).

invocation.args_spec: Named params -Prompt <text> (required); -Duration <seconds> (8; 1..30); -Guidance <n> (3.0; 0..15, classifier-free guidance); -Temperature <n> (1.0; 0..2, 0 = greedy); -TopK <n> (250; >=0); -TopP <n> (0.0; 0..1, 0 = off); -Seed <n> (-1 = random; actual seed recorded); -Normalize <bool> (true, peak-normalize to avoid clipping); -Format <wav|mp3|flac|opus|ogg|m4a> (wav); -SampleRate <hz> (0 = native 32000); -ConfidenceThreshold <0..1> (0.5, review floor); -Model <model_id> | -Tier <alias>; overrides -Registry/-PythonPath/-MusicInferPath/-AudioIngestPath/-ReviewQueuePath/-PwshPath. OR -InputsJson '<json {prompt,duration,guidance,temperature,top_k,top_p,seed,normalize,format,sample_rate,confidence_threshold,model,tier,registry,python_path,music_infer_path,audio_ingest_path,review_queue_path,pwsh_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.
invocation.engine: transformers MusicgenForConditionalGeneration (CUDA; Python worker under the speech venv)

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Text description of the music to generate (e.g. 'upbeat 8-bit chiptune, energetic').

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Target length in seconds (1..30). Converted to max_new_tokens via the model frame rate (~50 Hz).

inputs.name: guidance
inputs.description: Classifier-free guidance scale (0..15). Higher = follow the prompt more strictly.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: RNG seed. -1 = random (the actual chosen seed is recorded). A fixed seed >= 0 is reproducible on this GPU.

inputs.name: normalize
inputs.description: Peak-normalize the output to <= 0.99 to avoid PCM clipping (MusicGen can exceed +-1.0).

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output audio format: wav | mp3 | flac | opus | ogg | m4a. Non-wav is produced via audio.ingest (#10).

inputs.name: sample_rate
inputs.description: Output sample rate in Hz (8000..192000). 0 = native 32000. A non-native rate is resampled via audio.ingest.

inputs.name: confidence_threshold
inputs.description: Envelope confidence below this routes the generation to the review queue (verify_generation).

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: music-gen model_id in models.json (type=music-gen). Default = defaults.music (music.musicgen-small).

inputs.name: tier
inputs.description: music tier alias resolved via tiers.music. A named -Model wins.

requirements.gpu: cuda (RTX 2080 Ti; MusicGen Small runs on GPU, ~2.4 GB VRAM)
